Moves a channel to a bus. It is heard there from the next block of sound on. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
ch = PlaySound(door)
ChannelBus ch, world
```
@param channel  A channel handle from [PlaySound](PlaySound), [PlayMusic](PlayMusic) or [EmitSound](EmitSound).
@param bus  A bus from [CreateAudioBus](CreateAudioBus), or `0` for the master bus. Anything else is a runtime error.
@gap A channel that is over is ignored. [GetChannelBus](GetChannelBus) tells the bus of a channel, and [SoundBus](SoundBus) picks the bus that channels start on.
